obligations: Verify that OpenAiCompatibleImageProvider sends the configured model, trimmed prompt, and aspect ratio to the OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint and returns the provider URL.
Verify that createFallbackImageProvider invokes the next ImageProvider after a first provider failure and returns the succeeding data URL.

governingSources.clause: OpenAiCompatibleImageProvider.generate constructs POST request, parses URL/b64 response, and reports provider errors
governingSources.why: The test directly exercises request construction and URL response branch.

governingSources.clause: fallback provider invokes providers in order after failure
governingSources.why: The second test directly exercises fallback ordering.

governingSources.clause: F-CFG-01 provider configuration and image generation uses an OpenAI-compatible ImageProvider
governingSources.why: Establishes the product-level adapter role; it does not itself accept this unsealed test as live evidence.

governingSources.clause: XAI primary and OpenAI ordered operational fallback
governingSources.why: Supports fallback ordering context; provider acceptance remains separately gated.

governingSources.clause: unsealed discovered tests stop authoritative execution

fixturePaths: https://images.example/v1/ as a non-contacting example base URL
in-test failing and succeeding ImageProvider objects

executionPrerequisites.database: none; test imports only image provider modules and does not initialize or access db
executionPrerequisites.network: none during intended test; fetch is injected and the test never invokes the default global fetch
executionPrerequisites.credentials: none; literal 'secret' is passed only to assert request construction and is never sent because fetch is mocked
executionPrerequisites.liveAcceptance: not established; a real provider URL/key/model, network allowance, cost ceiling, moderation behavior, and independent readback would be required for any live image generation experiment

issues: The inventory has no current verification Seal, so the test must remain disabled under ADR-0058.

Coverage is limited to successful URL response and fallback order; it does not assert empty prompt, non-2xx/error parsing, malformed JSON, moderation filtering, empty data, or b64_json handling implemented by the adapter.
This unit test cannot prove xAI/OpenAI/Venice compatibility, R2 persistence, public media retrieval, or image quality. Those are separate integration/live acceptance gates.
staticImportAndSideEffectReview: Static imports are limited to image/fallback/types modules; no db/config import or default database initialization was observed. The only potential external side effect is the provider's default global fetch, but this test supplies an injected fetch in the OpenAI-compatible case and does not invoke a real endpoint.
